verdict.rationale: HumanLayer can create agent tasks directly from reported GitHub, Linear, or Jira issues, run them through a Oneshot or RPI (research-plan-implement) workflow on Claude Code or Codex, and have the agent open a draft PR. Non-interactive `humanlayer automation run` sessions from CI or scripts support autonomous execution. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bug diagnosis or debugging as a workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents fix reported bugs end-to-end.
